description: Search a Unity asset or one internal Property Tree subtree when unity_yaml_read has not already revealed the target path. Use the narrowest known scope. `path` uses the same asset-qualified syntax as unity_yaml_read, and every result path can be passed to unity_yaml_read unchanged for verification before editing. At a compound asset root, search covers the main object and every same-file Subasset and returns paths from the serialized-reference ownership hierarchy. The first same-file ObjectReference reached through serialized properties claims the child; non-serialized runtime fields never participate. Path matching keeps only the shallowest matching node on each branch, so a matching ancestor does not emit every descendant whose full path inherits the same query. Field-name and field-value matches remain separate results and include explicit evidence showing the matched field name and compact field value; type matches identify the matched type. When Unity is connected, search filters the live Editor Property Tree so unsaved values, all serialized array indices, and loaded Scene hierarchy changes are visible without transferring a whole asset; disk YAML is used only when the live target is unavailable. Search stops at shared/cyclic references after their first canonical path. Results omit repeated asset metadata.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring. Prefix with `re:` for a case-insensitive regular expression.

match_fields.description: Optional comma-separated scope: path, field_name, field_value, type, or all. Defaults to all.

limit.description: Maximum number of retained result nodes after shallow path de-duplication. Each field or type node remains an individual result.
